name: Outdoor Metal Conversation Set with Coffee Table
material: 2*1 teslin fabric laminated w/t vertical cotton, powder coated steel frame. Coffee table w/t 5mm-thick DPC board
description: Elevate your outdoor moments with the garden set from the Bali collection, thoughtfully designed for relaxed, easy entertaining. The coffee table’s natural wood-look tempered glass surface adds a warm, beautiful, and durable finish.  The two-seat loveseat and matching chairs create an inviting outdoor setup for warm-weather days. Breathable textilene seats and backrests provide comfort and a sleek, modern aesthetic.
